description: A call `invariant(true);` written right after a declaration's closer is read as an invariant clause; with a function named `invariant` in scope that reading is refused by name (E-DECL-INVARIANT-CAPTURES-CALL), never a silently dropped call.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S483-struct-invariant-syntax ("yes, your recommendations on all three plus the follow-up"); ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S482-struct-invariant-contract ("RULED yes (a)")
rationale: §66.13.5 rule 2 (r1): `invariant` followed by `(` right after a closer is the clause; when a binding named `invariant` is in scope there, the clause is E-DECL-INVARIANT-CAPTURES-CALL (fail closed).
